# Remote Loops Example (GitHub Actions)

Generated via `agent-toolkit loop schedule <name> --platform github-actions`.

## Generate

```bash
agent-toolkit loop schedule oss-triage --platform github-actions --dry-run
agent-toolkit loop schedule oss-triage --platform github-actions
cat .github/workflows/agent-toolkit-oss-triage.yml
```

## Example workflow (sanitized, no secrets)

```yaml
# Code generated by agent-toolkit loop schedule oss-triage --platform github-actions — DO NOT EDIT.
# Regenerate: agent-toolkit loop schedule oss-triage --platform github-actions
# Source: loops/oss-triage/loop.yaml (cadence: 1d → 0 0 * * *)
name: agent-toolkit — oss-triage (L1)

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: agent-toolkit-oss-triage
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write

jobs:
  run:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup uv + agent-toolkit
        run: |
          pip install -q uv
          uvx --from agent-toolkit-cli==1.18.0 agent-toolkit --help
      - name: Run loop
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: uvx --from agent-toolkit-cli==1.18.0 agent-toolkit loop run oss-triage --non-interactive
```

## Sync check

```bash
agent-toolkit loop sync --platform github-actions
# exits 1 if drifted; use --force to re-emit
```
